prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1427; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care, so we ask that all further communication regarding this claim be directed exclusively to our office and not to our client directly. Please do not contact our client by telephone, mail, or in person.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page and disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the insured driver. Please also confirm whether any other policies may provide coverage for this loss.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics footage, witness statements, adjuster notes, recorded calls, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim is pending.
